To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

two 4-bit mm-wave vector modulators have been designed and experimentally characterized in a 28-nm CMOS technology, and that the two circuits have a good performance in terms of gain, gain error, phase error, and linearity.
the two proposed phase shifters achieve a compact area and a good performance, which is suitable for mm-wave vector modulators and transmitters.

we designed and fabricated a 16-phase vector modulator phase shifter with a novel in-phase/quadrature signal generator that exploits the lumped-element quadrature coupler in a single-input double output amplifier.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and characterization of two 4-bit vector modulator active phase shifters exploiting novel IQ generators.
the implementation of a 16-phase vector modulator active phase shifter with an innovative IQ generator in 28 nm fully-depleted silicon-on-insulator (FDSOI) technology.

the realization of a novel vector modulator phase shifter architecture that exploits a novel single-input double-output (SISO) cascode amplifier that includes a lumped-element quadrature (90°) coupler.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed vector modulator active phase shifters, exploiting the novel IQ signal generator, represent a promising solution for mm-wave applications, in particular for phased arrays.
the two phase shifters have been demonstrated to be suitable for mm-wave phased array transceivers.
the proposed phase shifters are suitable for mm-wave applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a compact, low-power, and high-performance vector modulator phase shifter for mm-wave applications.
both phase shifters have a compact layout, a good phase linearity, a high $P_{1 dB}$ and NF.
we have demonstrated a 4-bit phase shifter that can be integrated with a 4-bit vector modulator to realize a 16-phase vector modulator phase shifter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a single-input double output amplifier is able to generate two orthogonal quadrature signals, thus reducing the area of the circuit.

the novel IQ generator is able to generate quadrature signals with a phase error of less than 12° over a bandwidth of 16.6 GHz, thus enabling the design of mm-wave phase shifters with a low phase error and high gain.

a compact, high-gain, high linearity, and low-power vector modulator phase shifter can be implemented in a 28-nm CMOS technology, which is of great significance for the future development of mm-wave phased array systems.
